instruction:
School Space Summary Model

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an OpenStudio 3.10 one-story school support model and save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.osm with size at least 500 bytes and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv with size at least 10 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10.
3. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:Building, 1 OS:BuildingStory, 6 OS:Space objects, and 6 OS:ThermalZone objects.
4. The OS:Space names are exactly Classroom-1, Classroom-2, Corridor, Restroom, Office, and Storage.
5. Every OS:Space references the OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, has Part of Total Floor Area set to Yes, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2.
6. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains at least one OS:DefaultConstructionSet and the single OS:Building references a default construction set.
7. The model has exactly 42 OS:Surface objects: 6 Floor surfaces, 6 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 30 Wall surfaces.
8. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 6 Ground, 20 Outdoors, and 16 Surface.
9. The model contains exactly 0 OS:SubSurface objects.
10. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 22.00 m, Y span 10.00 m, and Z span 3.40 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
11. The sum of floor surface areas is 176.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
12. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 217.60 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
13. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv has exactly the header row space_name,floor_area_m2,space_type_name,thermal_zone_name and 6 data rows in this order: Classroom-1, Classroom-2, Corridor, Office, Restroom, Storage.
14. Each /home/user/Desktop/result.csv floor_area_m2 value matches the evaluator-computed floor area for that space with tolerance +/-0.20 m2, and each CSV space_type_name and thermal_zone_name matches the corresponding OpenStudio object name.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
